summary: Correct the month from June to September
rationale: At 94/158 the Turoyo has 'bu yarḥo d ilən ... yaʕni bu payəz' (explicitly autumn), and the edition translates 'im September, d. h. also im Herbst'. 'Juni' contradicts both the month and its season. The secondary 94/182 citation is a separate attestation of the verb about cattle in spring.
